#Text=* use canvas bg color & reduce size and stroke width
#Text=feat: transparent link background, scale link icon when zooming to below 100%
#Text=Functionally, the icons are fine—but visually, they’re a bit distracting.
#Text=At low zoom levels or with non-white backgrounds, the icons remain relatively large and stand out too much.
#Text=This PR implements two minor visual improvements:
#Text=   – Gradually reduced icon size when zooming below 100%
#Text=fix(export): Remove redundant hsl() from background color
#Text=This PR fixes an issue where exported Images have an incorrect background color
#Text=- Copied Image incorrectly had a black background
#Text=- Downloaded SVGs incorrectly had a white background.
#Text=This change ensures that the background color of the exported SVG respects the current theme of the editor.
#Text=The code incorrectly wrapped a color value from a CSS variable with an hsl() function, creating an invalid color.
#Text=The fix removes the redundant hsl() wrapper, ensuring the background color value from the CSS variable is used directly and correctly.
#Text=docs: remarks about minor version (follow up to b6339b62a9522eb195a24ef74ee6392d65d2bfd7)
#Text=In mentioned commit a lot of "3.x+" badges were removed from docs and replaced with text "Only suported in 3.x+"
#Text=I found two more places, where 3.1 / 3.3 were still present, so I altered them in the same manner.
#Text=I also noticed sometimes the text is placed before function description and sometimes after.
#Text=I took liberty to unify the usage and put all of them **before**, because I think this good to know in advance whether I can use it in my project or not.
#Text=feat: do not delete frame children on frame delete (#9011)
#Text=feat: do not delete frame children on frame delete
#Text=This PR changes how frame deletion works.
#Text=Previously, we deleted the frame and its children.
#Text=Now we're only deleting the frame and keeping the children, selecting them instead.
#Text=This way it's much easier to remove children from the frame instead of having to do it through context menu in two steps.
#Text=If people want to delete both the frame and its children both, they can just hit delete twice.
#Text=(Un)related, fixed (or rather, improved, as a proper fix will take more work) selection on removing the last group member when editing a group.
